simple.meaning: חוּשׁ (chûwsh) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H2363). BibleIQ follows its 20 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, Job, and 4 more, beginning at Numbers 32:17. The surrounding context includes city, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to the Hebrew place-name חוּשׁ (H2363).
simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.

Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
Deliver my soul from the sword,
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it.
Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language,
Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul.
God, don’t be far from me.
I will hurry, and not delay,
Yahweh, I have called on you.
For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?
who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it;

definitions.short: to hurry ; figuratively, to be eager with excitement or enjoyment
definitions.full: H2363. chuwsh I. חוּשׁ verb haste, make haste (Assyrian —âšu, Dl Pr 180 , Ethiopic ; on this verb V. Nö ZMG 1883, 538 ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular חָשׁ Deut 32:35 (or Participle , but see Di), 1 singular חַשְׁתִּי Psa 119:60 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתַּ֫חַשׁ (sic!) Job 31:5 Ges § 72 R. 9; Imperative חוּ֫שָׁה 1Sam 20:38 6 t. Psalms, + Psa 71:12 Qr (Kt חישׁה ); Infinitive suffix חוּשִׁי Job 20:2 ; Participle active חָשׁ Hab 1:8 + Isa 8:1 , 3 in proper name; passive חֻשִׁיּם Num 32:17 ; but see below: — make haste Deut 32:35 (|| קרוב ), Psa 119:60 ; in prophetic proper name בַּז֑ חָשׁ שָׁלָל מַהֵר Isa 8:1 , 3 ; of eagle (in simile of Chald. army) לאכול חשׁ נשׁר Hab 1:8 ; Job 31:5 subject רנל , followed by עלמֿרמה ; בּי חוּ֫שִׁי 20:2 my haste in me , i.e. my inward excitement — especially Imperative 1Sam 20:38 (|| מהרה ), and in Psalms: followed by לְעַזְרָתִי 22:20 ; 1Sam 38:23; 1Sam 40:14; 1Sam 70:2; 1Sam 71:12 (Qr); followed by לִי 1Sam 70:6; 1Sam 141:1; passive participle חֻשִׁים נֵחָלֵץ Num 32:17 , but probably for חֲמֻשִׁים (Kn Di compare Exod 13:18 etc.); Ba NB 180 retains חוּשִׁים and regards it as active (intransitive) = hastening . Hiph`il Perfect הֵחִישׁוּ Judg 20:27 ; Imperfect יָחִישׁ Isa 28:16 ; יָחִ֫ישָׁה coh. 5:19 (Ges § 48 . 3); אָחִ֫ישָׁה coh. Psa 55:9 ; suffix אֲחִישֶׁנָּה Isa 60:22 ; — 1 shew haste, act quickly Judg 20:37 ; hasten, come quickly Isa 5:19 (subject מַעֲשֵׂהוּ , || יְמַהֵר ; others: let him hasten on his work ), יָחִישׁ 28:16 hasten away (flee), or hasten about distractedly (si vera lectio; Che Guthe read ימישׁ yield, give way ). 2 transitive with suffix Isa 60:22 I will hasten it ; with accusative Psa 55:9 I would hasten (= secure quickly) my escape. II. [ חוּשׁ ] verb feel, enjoy (with the senses) (Now compares Arabic feel, perceive by senses; Late Hebrew חוּשׁ feel pain ; Aramaic , חוּשׁ , feel pain ; Ethiopic : perception ) — only Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יָחוּשׁ וּמִי יאֹכַל מִּי Eccl 2:25 who can eat and who can feel (i.e. enjoy pleasure )?
